g.text: QP-ODE backend evaluation: physics sanity and Google MAIN fidelity

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5e6b7d

g.text: Curves: 53 held-out real events and 64 matched-seed simulations | Metrics: 256 simulations per model

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b1739

g.text: Result: the ODE backend is close on absolute response, but slightly worse on nearest shape and clearly worse on the decay-time distribution.

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #d54e4e

g.text: Current status: useful physics-informed experimental backend; not the recommended Google-data generator yet.

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #5e6b7d

g.text: The test split was previously inspected but was not used to tune QP parameters. QP parameters and the observation mapping remain uncalibrated to Google QP measurements.
